chunks: From him, from his father from Hammad from Hariz from whom he mentioned from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
That he did not see any harm in the one who is walking praying while he is walking, but he should not be driving the camels.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray while walking during travel in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) permits praying while walking, a ruling that addresses the practical needs of travelers in the pre-modern era, while explicitly excluding those actively driving their camels to ensure focus and stability. This distinction highlights the Shia juristic principle of linking the validity of prayer in motion to the degree of physical engagement and distraction, a nuance later expanded by scholars like Al-Shaykh al-Mufid and Al-Sharif al-Murtada to include various modes of transport.
